picks.headline: Tencent Releases Hy4 Preview Open-Weight 770B MoE Model
picks.why: Features 49B active parameters and a 1M-token context window in an open-weight release.
picks.title: Introducing Hy4 Preview

picks.headline: AWS Announces Agent Registry and Open ARD Specification for Agent Discovery
picks.why: Establishes an Apache 2.0 open standard for federated agent and tool discovery across multi-cloud environments.
picks.title: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD): An open specification for agent discovery

picks.headline: Confidential Computing on NVIDIA Blackwell Incurs Only 1-3% Overhead
picks.why: Benchmarks demonstrate that enterprise confidential VM inference on B200 GPUs adds minimal performance degradation.
picks.title: Benchmarking Confidential Computing Performance on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs

picks.headline: SARA Decouples Action Induction from Authorization to Block Agent Injections
picks.why: Offers an architectural defense against tool-output command injection in LLM agents, keeping attack success below 0.63%.
picks.title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents

papers.headline: Fabricated Evidence Tricks LLM Agents Into Committing to Unknowable Answers
papers.why: Demonstrates that visual and evidential packaging causes frontier agents to act on ungrounded claims over 50% of the time, exposing critical gating vulnerabilities.
papers.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

papers.headline: Puro-2B Demonstrates FP8 2B-Parameter Model Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
papers.why: Provides an open FP8 pretraining recipe that makes small language model pretraining feasible on single consumer GPUs for under $6,900.
papers.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

papers.headline: Test-Time Policy Optimization Improves LLM Reasoning Without Labeled Data
papers.why: Combines token-filtered self-distillation and grouped RL penalties during inference to refine model outputs via majority-vote pseudo-labeling.
papers.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
